snippet.title: Spelunker HD: Remake 2009 - Longplay (PS3) No Commentary
snippet.description: A forgotten/unappreciated Game That never saw a physical release. It was Digital only. Originally developed by Irem software. However when that Tsunami hit in Japan. Irem formed into Granzella. Tozai bought the rights to spelunker. Unfortunately Spelunker was Delisted soon after that. many years later in 2021. Spelunker HD Deluxe was released on PS4 & Nintendo switch. Also with a physical release. The HD Deluxe is pretty much the same game. Just some Graphics tweaks/such. Plus all the extras that were DLC in the PS3 version. I honestly would be shocked if anyone besides myself still plays the PS3 version. In America, this game is wildly skipped/ignored and unappreciated. Spelunker HD is a remake of the classic 80s NES/Arcade game.
